DSP: complex FFT and inverse MDCT (Vorbis synthesis).

Ports symphonia-core/src/dsp/{complex,fft/no_simd,mdct}.rs (scalar path; SIMD later via nimsimd). The FFT uses the unrolled 2/4/8/16/32 kernels plus the breadth-first generic merge with generated twiddles.

Complex32 = object
  re*, im*: float32
Fft = object
  perm*: seq[int]
Imdct = object
  fft*: Fft
  scratch*: seq[Complex32]
  twiddle*: seq[Complex32]
